provider.name: ViralZone
provider.organization_type: global virus taxonomy, virion, genome, replication, host-range, protein, molecular-process, illustration, bibliography, API, and download knowledge infrastructure
provider.description: ViralZone is a curated SIB/ExPASy knowledge resource describing viruses, virions, genome organization, replication strategies, host interactions, viral proteins, molecular processes, taxonomy, illustrations, and references, with extensive cross-links to UniProt, ICTV, NCBI, and structural databases.
institutional_context: ICTV, NCBI, structural databases, literature databases, and virology experts

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting ViralZone documentation, organization, virus taxonomy, names, Baltimore groups, genome properties, virion structure, replication cycles, host range, transmission, pathogenesis, viral proteins, references, APIs, downloads, schemas, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: ViralZone, SIB, ExPASy, UniProt, ICTV, NCBI, official sequence and structure databases, original virology literature, official public-health agencies, and cited authorities remain authoritative for taxonomy, sequences, structures, identifiers, versions, rights, clinical guidance, and contacts.
